title: DevBox configuration
description: User configuration (~/.config/devbox/config.json) or system configuration (/etc/devbox/config.json) of DevBox.

$schema.description: URL of the schema this file follows.

profiles.description: Profile sources, applied in this order; a later profile wins over an earlier one.

items.description: Source of one profile. Remote profiles are cached under ~/.cache/devbox/profiles/.

source.description: Location of the profile: file://, https://, git+https:// or git+ssh://.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit of a Git source.

path.description: Path of the profile file inside a Git repository.

trust.description: Sigstore identity that must have signed the profile; without it no signature is required.

plugins.description: Where plugins are loaded from and which ones are switched off.

paths.description: Plugin directories, searched in this order.

disabled.description: IDs of plugins that are switched off.

settings.description: Setting values keyed by <plugin>.<name>. Value types are checked against the plugin manifests when loading.

repositories.description: Repositories for plugins, catalogs, profiles, project templates and system packages, keyed by name.

listen.description: Address and port the service listens on.

auth.description: Login: local (Unix socket and 127.0.0.1 only, no login), pam (login with a system account), off (tests only; refuses to start on non-loopback addresses).

tls.description: TLS certificate for non-loopback addresses; when empty, DevBox creates a self-signed certificate.

key.description: Path to the private key file (PEM).

allowedOrigins.description: Additional origins accepted by the Origin check.

ui.description: Appearance of UI, CLI and terminal menu.

language.description: Language code for UI, CLI and terminal menu, e.g. de or en.
language.$comment: Must match an installed language pack; checked when loading, not in the schema.

accent.description: Accent colour from the zenit-ui accents.

backend.description: auto uses the Secret Service when the session provides one, otherwise an age-encrypted file; keyring and age force one backend. Changing the backend migrates all entries.

passphrase.description: Derive the age key from a passphrase asked for when the service starts, instead of the key file vault.key.

network.description: Network access of the core and the plugins.

proxy.description: Proxy URL for HTTP and HTTPS.

noProxy.description: Comma-separated hosts that bypass the proxy.

caFile.description: Path to an additional CA bundle (PEM).

repository.description: A repository with plugins, a catalog, a profile, project templates or system packages. The key of the entry is its ID in CLI, API and UI.

source.description: Location: git+https://, git+ssh://, https:// (tarball or index.json) or file://.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit; tags or commits are recommended for teams.

path.description: Sub-directory or file inside the source.

credential.description: Name of a credential instance (git-host or registry) for private repositories. The secret is passed only to Git or the download, never to plugins.

trust.description: How code from the repository is released: an object with a Sigstore identity (signature required), "prompt" (show and confirm permissions for every new version) or "pinned" (only the commit named in ref, without asking).

format.description: Package format of a packages repository.

url.description: Base URL of a packages repository.

suite.description: Suite of a packages repository, e.g. the distribution codename (apt).

key.description: URL of the signing key of a packages repository.

when.description: Limits the entry to distributions or architectures.

distro.description: Distribution IDs, e.g. ubuntu, debian, fedora.

locked.description: Set in a profile: an entry with the same name in the user configuration does not override this one.

repository.$comment: AP-27 adds if/then: packages requires format, url and key; all other kinds require source.

trust.description: Expected Sigstore signing identity; a valid signature is required.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer of the signing certificate.

identity.description: Certificate identity, e.g. the URL of the release workflow.
